body: Step into The Echelon Explorer, the inaugural luxury camper van from the partnership between Papago Vans and Mercedes-Benz of North Scottsdale. Designed to blend rugged capability with refined elegance, this Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD camper van redefines off-grid living. Whether tackling challenging terrains or relaxing under the stars, The Echelon Explorer delivers unmatched performance and comfort for van life enthusiasts.

Powered by a 200W solar system, 400Ah lithium battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter, this van ensures reliable energy for extended adventures. The Agile Off Road Lift Kit, all-terrain wheels and tires, and a CA Tuned front bumper with a Warn 12s winch make it an unstoppable force on any terrain. Equipped with an FVCO Safari Roof Rack, this van features a spacious rooftop deck, perfect for enjoying panoramic views, stargazing, or simply unwinding after a long day on the road. Complementing its rugged features are an electric awning with integrated LED lighting and a KC light bar for added convenience and visibility.

Inside, luxury meets functionality with a thoughtfully designed interior. The natural walnut slat ceiling, Luvih Fossil Grey cabinetry, and Papago White shiplap walls create a sophisticated yet cozy atmosphere. The kitchen is fully equipped with an Empava double burner induction cooktop, 700W microwave, and an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with freezer, ensuring effortless meal prep. Versatile design elements like a pop-up counter extension and fold-down exterior table make both indoor and outdoor dining a breeze.

Comfort is prioritized with a queen-size memory foam bed, a tiled wet-bath shower, and an Espar diesel heater, keeping you cozy no matter the climate. Stay connected with the WeBoost cell signal booster, and enjoy ample storage space for all your gear, thanks to smartly designed cabinets and compartments.

The Echelon Explorer is more than a camper van—it’s a lifestyle. Featuring a rooftop deck for ultimate relaxation, off-grid energy systems, and premium finishes, this custom build represents the future of luxury adventure vehicles. As the first of many in this collaboration, The Echelon Explorer highlights the unparalleled craftsmanship and innovation Papago Vans and Mercedes-Benz bring to the van life community.
